tools.name: principia.constructs.list
tools.description: List canonical constructs (resolved CanonicalVariable rows). Supports limit/offset, engagement_family_only, and abstraction_level (PRN-271).

tools.name: principia.constructs.lookup
tools.description: Lookup one canonical construct by id (a canonical variable_id, e.g. VAR_000376). Unknown ids return found:false (soft validation).

tools.name: principia.constructs.search
tools.description: Keyword search over construct name + definition + alternative_names + variable_codes. Argument is `q` (not `query`).

tools.name: principia.constructs.resolve
tools.description: Resolve a source-side construct {name, definition?, variable_code?} against the canonical store. READ-ONLY — does not mutate. Uses meta-factory's matcher (name@0.9 / code@0.85 / definition@0.6).

tools.name: principia.instruments.list
tools.description: List InstrumentCard rows. Optional construct_id filter narrows to instruments covering a given construct.

tools.name: principia.instruments.lookup
tools.description: Lookup one instrument by instrument_id. Unknown ids return found:false.

tools.name: principia.instruments.search
tools.description: Keyword search over instrument_name + developer + constructs_covered.

tools.name: principia.items.lookup
tools.description: Lookup one survey item by item_id. SPEC §6/Q4 enforced: items_license != public_domain|open returns status:'restricted'.

tools.name: principia.items.search
tools.description: Search items by text. Restricted items (proprietary instruments) are returned with text fields stripped; restricted_count surfaces how many.

tools.name: principia.citations.lookup
tools.description: Lookup one citation by id OR doi. Scans both id-keyed and doi-keyed candidates.

tools.name: principia.citations.search
tools.description: Keyword search over title + apa_reference + doi + authors.

tools.name: principia.measures.list
tools.description: List Measure rows. entity_kind filter selects scientific_construct vs operational_metric.

tools.name: principia.measures.lookup
tools.description: Lookup one Measure by measure_id. Unknown ids return found:false.

tools.name: principia.constructs.measures
tools.description: Return instruments that measure a given construct, ranked by composite score (reliability + validity + literature usage + recency). Optional filters: min_reliability, cross_cultural_only, length_lte. Read-only — no mutation (curator-policy D4).

tools.name: principia.models.list
tools.description: List Model rows (theoretical / structural frameworks).

tools.name: principia.models.lookup
tools.description: Lookup one Model by model_id. Unknown ids return found:false.

tools.name: principia.models.search
tools.description: Keyword search over model_name + description.

tools.name: principia.effects.search
tools.description: Search EffectSize rows by from/to/statistic_type. Each returned value's observed/corrected basis is named per EFFECT_ESTIMATE_GLOSSARY (@people-analyst/measurement-core) — PRN-N1013-M4; a row with no typed estimates block reads 'basis not recorded', never a bare statistic symbol.

tools.name: principia.evidence.for
tools.description: Return Evidence[] edges that name a given entity_id as the claim subject.

tools.name: principia.evidence_statements.search
tools.description: Search owned, OA-sourced, attributed, stance-classified evidence quotes for a construct→construct relationship (from/to), or any statement naming a single construct. Filters: stance, displayable_only. The display layer for the metric profile page + book.

tools.name: principia.canonical_priors.lookup
tools.description: Lookup a synthesized Bayesian prior by id OR (from_construct_id, predicate, to_construct_id). Empty until PRN-021 synthesis engine ships. PRN-N1013-M4: a prior's r pools observed and corrected contributing effects without a per-row marker yet (EFFECT_ESTIMATE_GLOSSARY.units_not_recorded, @people-ana

tools.name: principia.canonical_priors.search
tools.description: Search canonical priors by from/predicate/to. Empty until PRN-021 synthesis engine ships.

tools.name: principia.theoretical_models.list
tools.description: List canonical theoretical models (JD-R, COR, SDT, AET, JCM, Goal-Setting, Equity, Two-Factor, etc.). Sorted by foundational publication year. Read-only.

tools.name: principia.theoretical_models.lookup
tools.description: Look up one CanonicalTheoreticalModel by id (e.g., theory.jd_r). Returns the theory's canonical constructs, canonical relations (with predicates), descendant per-study models, and foundational citations.

tools.name: principia.theoretical_models.search
tools.description: Search theoretical models by keyword over name/summary/constructs. Optional filters: invokes_construct_id (theories that invoke a specific construct), field_domain (classification axis).

tools.name: principia.equivalences.lookup
tools.description: Look up InstrumentEquivalence rows by `id` OR by the canonical tuple (`construct_id` + `instrument_a` + `instrument_b` [+ optional `mapping_method`]). Pair ordering is normalized server-side so (Q12, UWES-9) and (UWES-9, Q12) resolve to the same row. Returns `{matches, total, note?}` — array-shaped

tools.name: principia.equivalences.search
tools.description: Search InstrumentEquivalence rows by `construct_id` and/or `instrument_id`. `instrument_id` matches either side of the pair. Optional `mapping_method` filter.

tools.name: principia.critiques.lookup
tools.description: Look up one MethodologyCritique by `critique_id`. Returns `{matches, total, note?}` — array-shaped for parity with equivalences. Matches list contains 0 or 1 element.

tools.name: principia.critiques.search
tools.description: Search MethodologyCritique rows by composite filter (`subject_id`, `subject_type`, `critique_type`, `severity`). All filters AND together; any subset of the four is valid. Read-only (curator-policy D4).

tools.name: principia.canonical_items.list
tools.description: List CanonicalSurveyItem rows (PRN-050 item-level dedup spine). Each row aggregates one normalized item stem across N source instruments via source_items[].

tools.name: principia.canonical_items.lookup
tools.description: Lookup one CanonicalSurveyItem by canonical_item_id (e.g., CITM_7350938cb42d). Unknown ids return found:false.

tools.name: principia.canonical_items.search
tools.description: Keyword search over normalized_text + alternative_texts. Optional instrument_id filter narrows to canonical items whose source_items[] reference that instrument.

tools.name: principia.evidence.trace
tools.description: Retrieve the full causal chain from a construct, condition, or problem to interventions, with evidence grades at each hop. problem_id accepts pf.* addresses from the problemframe-2026-v1 frozen registry (cert d0770859) and resolves construct mappings via the MF-711 pf→construct join (landed 2026-09-

tools.name: principia.interventions.lookup
tools.description: Look up one Intervention by `intervention_id`. Returns `{matches, total, note?}` — array-shaped for parity with critiques + equivalences. Matches list contains 0 or 1 element.

tools.name: principia.interventions.search
tools.description: Search Intervention rows by composite filter (`construct_id` — matches when `targets_constructs[]` includes the id; `problem_id` — a ProblemFrame pf.* address, resolved via the MF-711 pf→construct join to one or more construct ids and then matched the same way as `construct_id`; `modality` — matches

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "principia.evidence.trace" is 707 chars, far longer than this server's median (140). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
